en: Vintage sepia postcard with an ornate decorative border of leaves and scrolls. In the central framed photograph, a young girl lies on her side on a mat, dressed in a patterned wrap and light blouse, wearing a necklace. At the top of the frame, a banner reads 'East Coast of Africa.' Additional small printed credits appear along the left side, indicating a photographer in Lourenço Marques, Mozambique.
